title: Binance Will Add Kite (KITE) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Kite (KITE)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin , and  Binance Futures  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn KITE Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2025-11-03 13:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . Notes: Kite (KITE)  is the project on the Binance Launchpool, which allows users to lock their designated crypto assets to receive token airdrops at no extra cost. Users who subscribed to  BNB Simple Earn Products  (Flexible or Locked Products) or BNB  On-Chain Yields  will automatically participate in the Launchpool and receive new token rewards. Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  KITE  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay  or buy and sell  KITE  with their  account balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  KITE  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  KITE  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  KITE  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add  KITE  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  KITE/USDT  and  KITE/USDC  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2025-11-03 13:00 (UTC). Notes:  Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will convert the USDⓈ-M KITE Perpetual Contract pre-market trading to standard  USDⓈ-M KITE Perpetual Contract  gradually at  2025-11-03 13:00 (UTC) . The transition period  may take up to 3 hours , subject to price volatility and availability of stable index price. Trading and existing positions of the KITEUSDT Perpetual Contract will  not  be affected during the transition period. More details on the USDⓈ-M KITE Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below: USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract KITEUSDT Convert Time  2025-11-03 13:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset Kite (KITE) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.00001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 25x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  Pre-market Standard Perpetual Transition Period : Pre-market perpetual futures contracts will be converted to standard perpetual futures contracts when a stable index price can be derived from the spot market (as determined by Binance). The mark price will gradually converge from pre-market trading Mark Price to the standard Mark Price during the transition period, calculation as below: Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price)  Trading function is not affected during the transition period. Open orders and positions will not be cancelled. Mark Price After the Pre-Market Trading Ends:  When a pre-market perpetual futures contract ends, the Mark Price will be calculated using the following formula: Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price) Binance may impose a price cap on the mark price during the pre-market trading and pre-market standard perpetual transition period. The aforementioned perpetual contract will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  these FAQs . Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned perpetual contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned perpetual contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the aforementioned perpetual contract.  The aforementioned perpetual contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
